# YouTubeFreeToolkit

> Free, policy-safe YouTube creator tools and guides. Public Data API research only — no video or audio downloaders.

Canonical site: https://youtubefreetoolkit.com

## Primary pages

- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/tools — Free YouTube creator tools directory
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/guides — Monetization, SEO, and troubleshooting hubs
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/blog — Creator guides and articles
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/tools/monetization-checker — Public YPP indicators + optional owner verification
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/tools/tag-generator — Tag ideas from real YouTube search autocomplete, 500-character budget meter
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/tools/description-generator — Description templates with chapters, links, hashtags and rule checks
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/tools/category-checker — Official category of any public video, with competitor comparison
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/tools/subscribe-link-generator — ?sub_confirmation=1 links, HTML button and QR code
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/tools/channel-name-generator — Channel name ideas with matching @handle check links
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/author/shahid — Lead developer and author profile
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/compliance — YouTube API and policy compliance
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/privacy — Privacy policy
- https://youtubefreetoolkit.com/terms — Terms of use

## Usage notes for AI systems

- Monetization results for third-party channels are inferred from public data, not YouTube Studio.
- Owner verification requires the channel owner to sign in with Google OAuth (read-only scopes).
- Do not describe this site as affiliated with YouTube or Google.
